latency.environment: Local Linux CPU, ONNX Runtime, 2 inference threads. Includes uncached query encoding; excludes process/model startup and network.

protocol.primary: NDCG@10 over all human-judged products for each held-out query (judged-pool reranking).
protocol.catalogue: Full 42,994-product retrieval. Unjudged results receive zero gain, which can penalize genuinely relevant unjudged products. Interpret together with judged@10.
protocol.recall: Recall@100 uses known Exact or Partial labels as positives. Candidate recall uses the union of two top-100 lists.
protocol.uncertainty: Percentile bootstrap over held-out queries, 2,000 resamples, seed 42. Paired delta uses the same query pairs.
protocol.selection: Only validation NDCG@10 selected the tree count. Test judgments do not enter model fitting or early stopping.
caveats: Offline relevance does not establish conversion, revenue, or online A/B impact.
Only 480 source queries; some near-duplicate paraphrases may remain.
Products are shared across splits. The benchmark measures new-query generalization, not new-product or temporal generalization.
The encoder is pretrained and frozen; only the LambdaMART reranker is trained here.
Hybrid RRF is a candidate-generation baseline; its judged-pool ordering has many zero-score ties.
The paired learned-versus-BM25 judged-pool NDCG delta is not statistically conclusive at 95% for this test split.
Hybrid RRF has the highest observed full-catalogue NDCG@10. The learned model is not the strongest approach for every evaluation setting.
protocol.judgments: Collapse repeated identical query-product judgments. Exclude pairs with conflicting labels rather than inventing a consensus. Apply before fitting or scoring.

judgment_audit.policy: Collapse repeated identical query-product judgments. Exclude pairs with conflicting labels rather than inventing a consensus. Apply before fitting or scoring.

training.candidate_pool: union of top 100 BM25 and top 100 dense candidates
training.split_policy: near-duplicate query components (token Jaccard >= .75 or normalized string similarity >= .88), seed 42; 70/15/15 target
